'''Tuldok Ranch''' was a small, jagged plateau that rose above the [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] clouds of [[Recopia]]. It was home of the [[Tuldok clan]].<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
